E0342

`#Off` / `#DebugOnly` belongs before a statement.

What

`#Off` / `#DebugOnly` belongs before a statement.

Why

Statement switch attributes control code inside a function body, not top-level declarations.

Fix

Move it inside a function, or remove it from the declaration.
